about: Brief 115 P4 referees R1 (air leakage) and R2 (windows opening by temperature). One room at Denver, read by validation/energyplus/115_air_referee.py (EnergyPlus AirflowNetwork) and frontend/src/thermal/engine/__tests__/airBox.ts (Engine 2), so both are built from these inputs. Walls are split into three equal bands in EnergyPlus so each band's crack sits at the engine's crack height. Committed before the first run (Brief 114 review F5). Constructions are the Brief 104 cooled room's (104_cooled_room_spec.json).

weather.changed_after_first_run: Denver .mos at the first run; its wind direction column is not degrees (0 to 36,990). See docs/audit/115/02_referee.md.

window.note: EnergyPlus's SimpleOpening takes its link height (the window's centroid, 1.5 m) as the bottom of the opening; the engine's sill is therefore 1.5 m and its head 2.4 m, and EnergyPlus's external node for the window is put at 1.95 m (the engine's wind height, the opening's middle). Stated in docs/audit/115/02_referee.md.
